title: FreqCross: A Multi-Modal Frequency-Spatial Fusion Network for Robust Detection of Stable Diffusion 3.5 Generated Images
usefulness_reason: Presents a multi-modal network featuring a lightweight CNN for processing spectral features and spatial components, contributing to efficient/lightweight detector designs.
research_problem: Robust detection of Stable Diffusion 3.5 generated images by combining spatial RGB features, frequency domain artifacts, and radial energy distribution patterns.
key_findings: FreqCross achieves 97.8% accuracy on a dataset of 10,000 paired real and synthetic images, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines by 5.2%.
Synthetic images exhibit distinct spectral signatures in the 0.1-0.4 normalized frequency range.
